{{Quote|Doctor Soprin, here. We've finished our initial catalog of the cave artifacts, which register as over twenty thousand years old.|Doctor Soprin|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Soprin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] working for [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She was part of the team under [[Director/Legends|Director]] [[Antayen]] which worked on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] excavating an ancient alien device, which was in fact an [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] [[mind prison]] holding a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] known as [[the Imprisoned One]].

She was critical of Doctor [[Lerek]]’s wariness of the artifact and expressed relief when he left the team, though conceded that his theories regarding the artifact’s origins were logical. Lerek's concerns were later proven justified, as The Imprisoned One broke free and killed and enslaved almost all of the personnel present at research base at that time. As Soprin had been personally examining the mind prison at the time, she was more than likely the first to have been killed or enslaved by the Imprisoned One.
